_about: Describes this folder (India's lineage tables in the StableBound-India deposit) for stablebound's Lineage.from_folder(), so the tables load exactly as published: Lineage.from_folder('intermediates'). Generated by package_deposit.py from the master's lineage/stablebound.json; only the file names differ.
notes: ADM2 (district-level) lineage. Baseline is the 1991 admin snapshot — products are only valid for base_year >= 1991.

columns._about: Only headers that differ from stablebound's by more than case. The lineage tables need none: EVENT_YEAR is event_year once lowercased.

name_rules._about: Applied in this order, then stablebound's default tidying. 1) The DESAGRI statistics append the state code, 'Villupuram (TN)'; it is recognised by its capitals, so it is stripped before lowercasing (without it, statistics-name matching falls from 97.5% to 79%). 2) Variants of 'district', longest first. 3) Honorifics in official name lists.
